rules.rule: Whoever invites a foreign spouse for marriage cohabitation (the Korean spouse) needs pre-tax income over the 12 months before the visa application of at least the amount for their household size. Table in force from 2026-01-01: 2 people KRW 25,195,752; 3 people 32,154,216; 4 people 38,968,428; 5 people 45,340,314; 6 people 51,335,712; 7 people 57,090,900; 8 or more add KRW 5,755,188 per extra person. There is no 1-person row, because the inviter and the invited spouse already make 2.
rules.whose: sponsor household (Korean spouse plus counted family)
rules.conditions: Visa application or change to F-6-1 under 시행규칙 제9조의5제1항제4호. Effective 2026-01-01, issued 2025-12-31. Replaced every January.
rules.effect: Below the amount (and with no exemption and no asset or family top-up) the F-6-1 is refused.
rules.stacks: Can be topped up with assets (5% of net assets) and with income of lineal family on the same resident registration. See the F-6-1 assets and exemption rules.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2025-534호 「결혼동거 목적의 사증 발급에 필요한 요건 및 심사면제 기준 고시」 (2025-12-31, 시행 2026-01-01), https://www.moj.go.kr/bbs/moj/184/488780/download.do (also law.go.kr flDownload flSeq=160579555). Seen through WebSearch extracts.
rules.quote: 외국인을 결혼동거 목적으로 초청하는 사람(이하 '초청인')은 과거 1년간(사증발급 신청일 기준)의 연간소득(세전)이 아래 표에 해당되는 금액 이상이어야 함 | 2인 25,195,752 / 3인 32,154,216 / 4인 38,968,428 / 5인 45,340,314 / 6인 51,335,712 / 7인 57,090,900 / 8인 이상: 7인 기준에 1명당 5,755,188원씩 추가

rules.rule: The F-6 income table is exactly 50% of the Ministry of Health and Welfare's 2026 기준 중위소득 (standard median income), times 12 months, for each household size. It is not tied to GNI. Every row matches to the won: 2인 4,199,292 x 6 = 25,195,752; 3인 5,359,036 x 6 = 32,154,216; 4인 6,494,738 x 6 = 38,968,428; 5인 7,556,719 x 6 = 45,340,314; 6인 8,555,952 x 6 = 51,335,712; 7인 9,515,150 x 6 = 57,090,900. The 8+ step 5,755,188 = (9,515,150 - 8,555,952) x 6.
rules.amount: 50% of the 2026 standard median income, annualised
rules.conditions: Calendar year 2026. The 2027 median income has been announced (about +6.5-6.7%), so a new F-6 table should apply from 2027-01-01.
rules.effect: Explains the numbers. Use the median-income table (not GNI) when updating the text each January.
rules.source: Arithmetic from the 고시 2025-534 table against the 2026 기준 중위소득 (보건복지부 고시, as listed by studygov.kr / jab-guyver.co.kr search extracts)
rules.quote: 2026년 공식 기준 중위소득은 1인 가구 2,564,238원, 2인 가구 4,199,292원, 3인 가구 5,359,036원 ... 7인 가구 9,515,150원 / 8인 이상 가구는 7인 가구 기준에 7인 가구와 6인 가구의 차액을 더해 산정

rules.rule: Counted income is the sum of employment, business (including farming, forestry and fishing), real-estate rental, interest, dividend and pension income over the past year. Irregular income is excluded. Business income is judged by the tax-office income certificate.
rules.conditions: Past 12 months before the visa application. The tax-office 소득금액증명 is required for everyone using income.
rules.effect: Only these income types count toward the table amount.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2025-534호 (WebSearch extract); 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 33. 결혼이민(F-6) › F-6-1 › 제출서류 (data/visadocs.yaml F-6-1, incomeAmountCertificateOriginal / businessRegistrationCopy notes)
rules.quote: 소득은 과거 1년간(사증 신청일 기준) 근로소득, 사업소득(농림수산업 포함), 부동산 임대소득, 이자소득, 배당소득, 연금소득을 합산 ... 이 외의 비정기 소득은 제외 / 근로소득 활용 시 · 사업소득 활용 시 · 기타 소득 활용 시

rules.rule: Assets can make up a shortfall: 5% of the inviter's net assets (deposits, insurance, securities, bonds, real estate, minus debts) counts as income. Only assets held 6+ months count. The manual counts deposits only from KRW 1,000,000 held 6+ months; real estate needs the registry extract and the official price sheet. Example in the notice: KRW 20M income plus KRW 120M assets (5% = 6M) meets the 2-person line.
rules.conditions: The assets must be the inviter's, or those of counted family members on the same resident registration. Debts come from the credit report (신용정보조회서).
rules.effect: Asset value x 0.05 is added to income.
rules.stacks: Adds to income. Unlike F-5, assets and income CAN be combined here.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2025-534호 example and MOFA consulate F-6 income notices (WebSearch extract over moj.go.kr / mofa.go.kr); 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 F-6-1 제출서류 (data/visadocs.yaml depositsInsuranceSecuritiesBonds / realEstate notes)
rules.quote: 재산의 5%를 소득으로 인정 ... 취득일로부터 6개월 이상 지속된 것으로 한정 ... 부채가 있는 경우 재산에서 부채를 뺀 순자산의 5%만 인정 / 소득 2,000만원에 재산 1억 2,000만원(5%인 600만원) / 재산 활용 시: Only amounts of ₩1,000,000+ held 6+ months count

rules.rule: Family can top up the inviter's income or assets. Only lineal family on the same resident registration as the Korean spouse (parents, grandparents, children) can do this, or the invited foreign spouse with Korean income or assets of the past year. Siblings cannot. A 'statement of the inviter's family income' (가족소득 현황 진술서) is required. The household size used for the table = the inviter + the spouse + lineal family on the same resident registration.
rules.conditions: Same resident registration (세대). Family income must be Korean income of the past year.
rules.effect: Widens whose income counts, and also raises the household size (and so the threshold).
rules.stacks: Adds to the inviter's income and asset equivalent.
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 33 › F-6-1 › 제출서류 (data/visadocs.yaml statementOfTheInviterSFamilyIncome, onlyKo 가족의 소득 또는 재산 활용 시); household count from inblog.ai/kvisa leads
rules.quote: 가족의 소득 또는 재산 활용 시 — Only lineal family on the same resident registration as the Korean spouse (parents, grandparents, children) or the invited spouse can top up, with Korean income/assets of the past year; siblings cannot / 기본은 초청인과 배우자 2인입니다. 여기에 주민등록표상 세대를 같이 하는 직계가족을 더합니다. 형제자매는 제외

rules.rule: There is no income requirement when (1) the couple has a child born to them; (2) the couple has lived together abroad for 1+ year before the visa application, so there is no Korean income in the last year; or (3) the foreign spouse held F-6 before in the same, uninterrupted marriage (the simplified re-application list).
rules.conditions: Proof: the child's family-relation certificate; proof of living together abroad; the earlier F-6 record. Case (3) does not apply if the spouse changed or the marriage was interrupted.
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 33. 결혼이민(F-6) › F-6-1 › 제출서류 and 서류 간소화 사례별 구비서류 목록 (data/visadocs.yaml F-6-1 variants 2 and 4); 법무부고시 제2025-534호 부칙/면제 (extract)
rules.quote: 소득요건 적용 면제 ① 부부 사이에 태어난 자녀가 있는 경우 / 소득요건 적용 면제 ② 부부가 비자 신청일로부터 1년 이상 외국에서 동거하여 최근 1년간 국내 소득이 없는 경우 / Not needed if exempt from the income requirement: ... the foreign spouse stayed in Korea on F-6 before with the same, uninterrupted marriage

rules.rule: The invited spouse must show basic Korean or a way to communicate. One of these is enough: TOPIK level 1+ (TOPIK IBT accepted); a Korean Education Centre level 2 or King Sejong Institute beginner 1A+1B certificate (120+ hours); a certificate from a designated Korean-language institution; a Korea-related degree; ethnic-Korean status; or proof of a shared language. Shared-language proofs: the foreign spouse stayed in Korea 1 continuous year; the Korean spouse lived 1 continuous year in the partner's country; the Korean spouse is naturalised from that country; both lived 1 year in a third country; or another language test or an embassy interview. A MOJ extract also names KIIP level 2+. This is waived (no Korean-ability documents in the simplified lists) when the couple has a child together, or the spouse held F-6 before in the same marriage.
rules.conditions: 시행규칙 제9조의5제1항제6호; criteria set by 고시 2025-534
rules.effect: If not met, the visa is refused unless exempt.
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 33 › F-6-1 › 제출서류 section 3 and 서류 간소화 lists (data/visadocs.yaml); 법무부고시 제2025-534호 (moj.go.kr extract)
rules.quote: TOPIK 초급 1급 이상이나 KIIP 2단계 이상 이수 / 한국교육원(한국어강좌 2단계) 수료증, 세종학당(초급1A+1B) 수료증 / Choose one; TOPIK level 1 or higher (TOPIK IBT accepted)

rules.rule: No income or asset test for the parent raising a Korean minor child (F-6-2), at change of status, at the visa from abroad or at extension. The manual's lists hold no income documents. The income test comes back only at F-5-2 (household 1x GNI or median assets).
rules.conditions: Raising, in Korea, a minor child born of a (de facto) marriage with a Korean.
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 33. 결혼이민(F-6) › 자녀 양육자(F-6-2) 변경허가/연장허가; 사증발급 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.1 › 34 › 2. 자녀양육 (F-6-2) (data/visadocs.yaml F-6-2)
rules.quote: 자녀 양육자에 대한 체류자격(F-6-2) 변경허가 › 다. 제출서류 (no 소득 documents listed)

rules.rule: No income or asset test for a marriage migrant whose marriage ended through the Korean spouse's death, disappearance or fault (F-6-3), at change of status or at extension. Only proof of the cause and of the earlier married life is asked for.
rules.conditions: Marriage ended, not the applicant's fault.
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 33 › 혼인단절자(F-6-3) 변경허가 / 연장허가 (data/visadocs.yaml F-6-3)
rules.quote: 혼인단절자(사망,실종,이혼)에 대한 체류자격(F-6-3) 변경허가 › 다. 제출서류 (no 소득 documents listed)

rules.rule: To invite a spouse, the F-5 holder (the inviter) needs income over the 12 months before the application of at least the previous year's per-capita GNI. This can be the inviter's own income or the combined income of family living together and sharing a livelihood. Counted: wages, business income (incl. freelance and farming), real-estate rental, interest, dividends and pensions; irregular income is excluded. This confirms the 1x GNI multiple in our data. The test is on the inviter's household, not on the invited spouse.
rules.conditions: Spouse invitation (결혼동거), visa from abroad or change of status
rules.effect: Below it, the spouse's F-2-3 is refused (unless waived).
rules.stacks: See the 70% rule for households of 3 or fewer.
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2015-2호 영주자격자의 배우자 결혼 동거 목적 사증 발급에 필요한 소득요건 고시 (round 2 R4b, admrule mirror of law.go.kr). Not re-found this round; the immikorea F-2-3 lead also says 'GNI 이상'.
rules.quote: 외국인을 결혼동거 목적으로 초청하는 영주자격 소지자(초청인)는 신청일 기준 과거 1년간의 본인 또는 생계를 같이 하는 동거가족의 소득 합계*가 한국은행고시 전년도 일인당 국민총소득GNI 이상** 이어야 함

rules.rule: If the household sharing a livelihood, counting the inviter, has 3 members or fewer, 70% of GNI is enough. With 4 or more, the full 1x GNI applies. A plain couple (2 people) therefore needs only 70%.
rules.conditions: Household of 3 or fewer, inviter included
rules.quote: 본인 포함 생계를 같이하는 동거가족의 수가 3인 이하인 경우에는 GNI 70% 이상이면 인정

rules.rule: The minor child of an F-5 holder has no income test. The manual's change list for 'Minor child of an F-5 holder' asks only for the form, passport, photo, fee and proof of family relationship, and the extension list has no income document either. The income notice covers spouse (결혼동거) invitations only.
rules.conditions: Minor (under 19) child of an F-5 holder
rules.effect: No income gate for the child.
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 30. 거주(F-2) › 체류자격 변경허가 › 2. 영주자격 소지자의 배우자 및 미성년 자녀 (data/visadocs.yaml F-2-3 change 'Minor child of an F-5 holder')
rules.quote: Minor child of an F-5 holder: applicationFormForm342, passport, 1StandardPhoto, fee, proofOfFamilyRelationshipEGBirthCertific (no income document)

rules.rule: The spouse income requirement is waived on humanitarian grounds, such as a child born to the couple or a pregnancy. Other inviter conditions (from leads): an inviter who got F-5 as a Korean's spouse (별표 1의3 제2호) may invite only 3+ years after getting F-5, and no other spouse may have been invited in the last 5 years.
rules.source: Korean consulate Toronto F-2-3 page (round 2 R4b, search summary); immikorea.com F-2-3 post (lead)
rules.quote: 초청인과 피초청인 사이에 출생한 자녀가 있거나 임신한 경우 등 인도적 사유가 있는 경우 / 초청인이 출입국관리법 시행령 별표1의3 제2호에 따라 영주자격을 취득한 경우 영주자격 취득 후 3년이 경과해야 함 / 최근 5년 이내에 다른 배우자를 초청한 이력이 없을 것

rules.rule: The spouse or minor child of a general F-5 holder needs the livelihood requirement: the tax-office income of the applicant and of each household earner counted (calendar year before the application) at 1x GNI. The alternative is household assets (자산보유 기준); income and assets cannot be added together. No 70%-for-small-households rule was found for F-5-4: that reduction belongs to the F-2-3 spouse invitation. The exact multiple is not stated in the transcribed list; 1x GNI is the general F-5 family-route level and was not refuted.
rules.amount: 1x GNI = KRW 52,416,000 (multiple not confirmed by official text); assets: amount not found
rules.conditions: 2+ years in Korea as spouse or minor child of an F-5 holder (별표 1의3 제2호)
rules.effect: Below it (and without the asset route) the F-5-4 is refused.
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 3. 일반 영주자의 배우자 또는 미성년 자녀〔F-5-4〕 › 다. 제출서류 (data/visadocs.yaml F-5-4 change); round 2 R3
rules.quote: incomeAmountCertificate: One per income earner counted. Income = taxed income of the calendar year before the application / 자산보유 기준 — Assets must have been held 6+ months and kept until the decision ... Income and assets cannot be added together.

rules.rule: Basic-knowledge proof: KIIP completion (PR or naturalization track), or a KIPRAT/KINAT pass. TOPIK 4-6 was accepted only for applications filed by 2019-03-31. Exempt: minors under 15, and minors 15+ in regular education.
rules.quote: Submit at least one: KIPRAT pass certificate (PR comprehensive test); KINAT pass certificate; KIIP completion certificate, PR track; KIIP completion certificate, naturalization track ... Exempt: minors under 15, and minors 15+ enrolled in regular education.

rules.rule: The spouse or minor child of an F-2-7 holder gets F-2-71 only if the F-2-7 holder's own annual income is at least the latest per-capita GNI. Below that, the family stays on F-1 (visiting cohabitation) in Korea, or gets a 90-day single-entry F-3-18 visa from abroad. They move to F-2-71 once the holder reaches 1x GNI. The holder's latest tax-office income certificate is used (for KOSPI/KOSDAQ employees who cannot submit one, the contract salary).
rules.effect: Below 1x GNI: F-1 / F-3-18 instead of F-2-71.
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 29. 방문동거(F-1) › 체류기간 연장허가 › 11. 점수제 우수인재(F-2-7)의 배우자 또는 미성년자녀 (data/visadocs.yaml F-1 extend case); 사증발급 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.1 › 31 (F-3-18); immikorea.com/f-2-7 (lead)
rules.quote: Spouse or minor child of a points-based talent (F-2-7) whose annual income is below the latest per-capita GNI / 주 체류자의 연간 소득이 GNI 이상이 안되는 경우 F-1 비자를 받게 됩니다.

rules.rule: For the family of a K-STAR resident (F-2-7S), the manual's own F-2-71 list (41. K-STAR 비자트랙 › Ⅳ. K-STAR의 동반가족) asks for no income proof at all: only the form, passport, ARC, photo, fee, residence proof, family relationship, and TB and criminal-record certificates where applicable. The GNI-sponsor test is documented only for F-2-7 holders.
rules.effect: Probably no GNI gate for K-STAR families.
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 41. K-STAR 비자트랙 › Ⅳ. K-STAR의 동반가족(F-2-71, F-5-S2) › 3. › (5) 제출서류 (data/visadocs.yaml F-2-71 change, 2nd case)
rules.quote: Spouse or minor child of a K-STAR resident (F-2-7S): applicationForm, passport, alienRegistrationCard, photo, fee, proofOfResidenceInKorea, proofOfFamilyRelationship2, tbScreeningCertificate (해당자에 한함), foreignCriminalRecordCertificate2 (해당자에 한함)

rules.rule: No sponsor income test is documented for F-3 dependants of D/E/F-2/F-4/H-2 holders: the manual's F-3 visa, change and extension lists ask only for family-relation and stay documents. The one income-linked F-3 case is the F-2-7 family: an F-2-7 holder below 1x GNI gets them F-3-18 (90-day single-entry) or F-1. Since June 2024 E-7-4 families have their own code F-3-74; its sponsor conditions were not found.
rules.conditions: Sponsor on D-1, D-2, D-4 to E-7, F-2, F-4 or H-2. D-3, E-8, E-9, E-10 holders cannot invite family on F-3.
rules.effect: No income gate; the sponsor's status alone decides.
rules.source: 사증발급 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.1 › 31. 동반(F-3) › 공관장 재량 / 사증발급인정서; 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 31. 동반(F-3) (data/visadocs.yaml F-3); 법무부 비자 내비게이터 (immigration.go.kr); 법무부 보도자료 2026-06-01 (F-3-74)
rules.quote: Spouse or unmarried minor child of a D-1, D-2, D-4–E-7, F-2, F-4 or H-2 holder: consular single-entry visa, stay up to 1 year / E-1(교수)~E-7(특정활동) 자격 소지자는 배우자 및 미성년 자녀를 F-3(동반) 자격으로 초청 가능 / 숙련기능인력(E-7-4) 40,858명, 동반(F-3-74, '24. 6월 코드 신설) 13,564명

rules.rule: GNI multiples for F-2-3, F-2-71, F-5-2 and F-5-4 use KRW 52,416,000 (2025 per-capita GNI, Bank of Korea) for applications filed 2026-04-01..2027-03-31. The F-6-1 table is NOT GNI-based: it uses 50% of the standard median income and changes on 1 January.
rules.source: Round 2 R4b (HiKorea GNI notice Mar 2026 via gnscfw.org; BoK 2026-03-10); data/visamap.yaml gni {year: 2025, krw: 52.416}

dataDiscrepancies.location: data/visamap.yaml statuses F-2-3.how (en, ru, uz, uz-cyrl)
dataDiscrepancies.current: Spouse or minor child of an F-5 holder, whose household earns at least 1× GNI (70% for up to 3 people).
dataDiscrepancies.correct: The multiple is CONFIRMED (1x GNI, 70% when the inviter's household is 3 people or fewer). However, it applies only to the SPOUSE invitation and is waived on humanitarian grounds (a child together, pregnancy). A minor child has no income test. Suggested en: 'Spouse or minor child of an F-5 holder. To invite a spouse, the F-5 holder's household needs income of 1× GNI over the last year (70% if the household is 3 people or fewer; waived with a child together or a pregnancy). No income test for a minor child.'

notes: 16 of 16 WebSearch calls used. Main new primary finding: 법무부고시 제2025-534호 「결혼동거 목적의 사증 발급에 필요한 요건 및 심사면제 기준 고시」 (dated 2025-12-31, in force 2026-01-01; https://www.moj.go.kr/bbs/moj/184/488780/download.do, also on law.go.kr). It sets the F-6-1 inviter income table (2인 25,195,752 / 3인 32,154,216 / 4인 38,968,428 / 5인 45,340,314 / 6인 51,335,712 / 7인 57,090,900 / +5,755,188 per person from 8) and the Korean-language criteria. Every row equals 50% of the 2026 기준 중위소득 x 12, so the F-6 line is median-income based, not GNI based, and changes each 1 January. The data's '₩25.2M for a couple' is correct. What it misses: the household-size scaling, family and asset top-ups (5% of net assets held 6+ months; assets and income may be combined for F-6, unlike F-5), two further income exemptions (lived together abroad 1+ year; earlier F-6 in the same marriage), and the fact that a child together also waives the language requirement. The manual's simplified lists (data/visadocs.yaml F-6-1 variants 2 and 4) carry no income or Korean-ability documents. F-2-3: the data's '1× GNI (70% for up to 3 people)' matches 고시 2015-2 (round 2, primary) but applies to the spouse invitation only; the minor child has no income test. F-5-4: 1x GNI household or assets; there is NO 70% small-household rule. F-2-71: 1x GNI on the F-2-7 holder's own income (else F-1 / F-3-18); K-STAR families may be exempt. F-6-2 / F-6-3: no income test. F-3: no sponsor income test documented; the sponsor list in the data is too broad (D-3, E-8, E-9 and E-10 cannot invite) and too narrow (F-4 and H-2 can). Engine note: the F-6-1, F-2-3 and F-2-71 tests are SPONSOR-side. The engine compares the reader's own income, so these should not be wired as reader-income gates without a 'whose: sponsor' notion.
